facts.text: The hotel sits on the upper levels of a 58-floor tower in Lujiazui, Shanghai's commercial, financial and upscale retail district.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on the upper levels of a stylish 58-floor tower in Lujiazui

facts.text: The hotel's design merges Art Deco elegance with contemporary design.
facts.excerpt: Art Deco elegance beautifully merges with contemporary design

facts.text: Rooms and suites overlook the Shanghai skyline and have Art Deco accents.
facts.excerpt: accommodations that overlook the Shanghai skyline. Sophisticated comfort awaits in luxury hotel rooms and suites that have been masterfully designed with modern amenities and Art Deco accents

facts.text: Flair is a rooftop restaurant and bar on the 58th floor, in the center of Lujiazui.
facts.excerpt: rooftop venue on the 58th floor, FLAIR is located right in the center of Lujiazui

facts.text: Jin Xuan Chinese Restaurant serves Cantonese cuisine and regional Chinese favorites, on the 53rd floor.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 53rd floor of The Ritz-Carlton Shanghai, Pudong, Jin Xuan Chinese Restaurant tempts guests with authentic, creative Cantonese cuisine and regional favorites in China.

facts.text: Jin Xuan was designed by Hong Kong interior designer and architect Steven Leung.
facts.excerpt: Jin Xuan was designed by the renowned interior designer and architect from Hong Kong, Steven Leung.

facts.text: Scena di Angelo is an Italian restaurant with Michelin-starred chef Angelo Aglianó as head chef, with views of the Bund.
facts.excerpt: Italian Michelin-Star Chef Angelo Aglianó has been invited to serve as head chef

facts.text: In November 2025 Scena di Angelo received the Gambero Rosso Two Forks award.
facts.excerpt: In November 2025, SCENA DI ANGELO was honored with the prestigious

facts.text: Aura Lounge serves tea, coffee, light fare and Afternoon Tea, followed by live music and handcrafted cocktails.
facts.excerpt: this day-to-evening venue offers tea, coffee, light fare and the signature Afternoon Tea, followed by live music and handcrafted cocktails.

facts.text: The spa is on the 55th floor and has a dry sauna, steam room and heated indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Rise above the energetic streets of Shanghai to a peaceful retreat on the 55th floor

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge is on level 49 and has floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Bund and Huangpu River.
facts.excerpt: Located at level 49 of the hotel, the Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge features floor-to-ceiling windows, offering magnificent views of the Bund and Huangpu River.

facts.text: The Club Lounge offers five complimentary food and beverage presentations each day.
facts.excerpt: Five times each day, the Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations.

facts.text: The Club Lounge holds a weekly Caviar and Champagne night every Friday.
facts.excerpt: Caviar and Champagne night, every Friday

facts.text: Ritz Kids Night Safari lets children set up camp in a tent in the guest room.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Kids Night Safari brings the great outdoors inside by allowing your children to set up camp in your room.

facts.text: Ritz Kids Night Safari requires advance reservation.
facts.excerpt: Advanced reservation is required for Ritz Kids Night Safari experience.

facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary Club access.
facts.excerpt: Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The Ritz-Carlton Shanghai, Pudong.

facts.text: The hotel is surrounded by Fortune 500 company offices, the Shanghai New International Expo Centre and attractions such as the Shanghai Ocean Aquarium.
facts.excerpt: This luxury hotel surrounds guests with more than 300 Fortune 500 companies, the Shanghai New International Expo Centre and modern attractions such as the Shanghai Ocean Aquarium.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the hotel fills the top floors of a 58-story financial district building, a quick walk from the Oriental Pearl Tower.
facts.excerpt: The Pudong hotel fills the top floors of a 58-story financial district building that's a quick walk from the iconic Oriental Pearl Tower.
